processes.name: Payment Settlement & Gateway (PCI-DSS)
processes.description: Critical cardholder data environment, checkout APIs, and financial transaction settlement.
processes.impact_template: Direct threat to payment settlement pipeline; elevated risk of transaction manipulation, wire redirection, or PCI-DSS cardholder data compromise.

processes.name: Core Active Directory & IAM Authority
processes.description: Central identity provider, Kerberos domain controllers, and privileged credential vaults.
processes.impact_template: Core identity authority or privileged account impacted; high potential for domain-wide golden ticket creation, privilege escalation, and lateral movement.

processes.name: Customer-Facing Ingress & Web DMZ
processes.description: Public reverse proxies, web application servers, and external API gateways.
processes.impact_template: Perimeter service exploit or unauthorized ingress activity; threat to customer service availability and potential perimeter foothold.

processes.name: Corporate ERP & Supply Chain
processes.description: Enterprise resource planning, relational databases, supply chain logistics, and HR databases.
processes.impact_template: Corporate ERP or backend database impacted; potential disruption to supply chain logistics or unauthorized business records access.

processes.name: Non-Production Dev & Lab Sandbox
processes.description: Software development staging nodes, QA clusters, and test environments.
processes.impact_template: Isolated development or QA asset activity; low enterprise operational risk, suppressed from high-urgency SOC response.

time_windows.name: Month-End Financial Close Window
time_windows.description: Heightened scrutiny period for accounting, banking, and payment systems during reconciliation.

time_windows.name: Scheduled Infrastructure Maintenance
time_windows.description: Authorized patching and vulnerability assessment window; technical alerts de-escalated to reduce alarm fatigue.

time_windows.name: Unattended Off-Hours Operations
time_windows.description: Night-time and weekend operations when physical offices are unoccupied and SOC staffing is lean.
